meta.name: Tires
meta.description: At his father's auto shop, a hapless manager strives to improve customer service and drive profits while keeping his troublemaking cousin in line.

videos.title: The Initiative
videos.overview: At the Valley Forge Auto shop, manager Will pushes a new inclusion initiative and invites a reporter to cover it, but the interview goes off the rails.

videos.title: Windows of Opportunity
videos.overview: With sales down, Dave pressures Will to send a mechanic to another shop. Meanwhile, Shane reconnects with an old friend who proposes a tempting offer.

videos.title: Sales Contest
videos.overview: To beat Belmont's team in sales and win a gift card, the shop draws in customers with an oil change special, but Will's upselling attempts fall short.

videos.title: The Rumor Mill
videos.overview: Will tries to build a marketing campaign for his new idea — until devastating rumors about the store's future and his reputation throw him off-balance.

videos.title: Bikini Car Wash
videos.overview: Will and Shane prepare for a fun day on the job after hiring women for an attention-grabbing car wash but are forced to pivot when a visitor drops in.

videos.title: Dad
videos.overview: Will hits a low point after clashing with his toughest critic over his life choices. An unlikely advocate steps in to help save his job — and the shop.
